verdict.rationale: gstack collects usage data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence documents a control or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The only privacy-related item is a community note that usage telemetry can be opted out of. That is an adjacent control, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
